local NpcAttributeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.NpcAttributeValue
local GroundValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.GroundValue
local GridType = MapHelper.GridType
local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()

local _animalLifeTime = 300

local _carrotSpawnMarks:{boolean} = {}
local _groundBunnys:{Model} = {}
local _groundIsCanSpawnBunny:{boolean} = {}
local _groundAnimals:{Model} = {}
local _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal:{boolean} = {}
-- local _nextCheckEnterTime:{Part} = {}

function trySpawnTreeTrunk(ground:Part)
    -- 判断是否为可生成动物的地块
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if zoneLevel > 2 then return end

    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= GridType.land and gridType ~= GridType.campfireLand then return end
    local isSpawn = math.random(1,2) == 1
    if not isSpawn then return end

    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local posX = ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX)
    local posZ = ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ResourcesItemHelper:CreateTreeTrunk(Vector3.new(posX,posY,posZ))
end

function trySpawnCarrot(ground:Part)
    if _carrotSpawnMarks[ground] then return end
    _carrotSpawnMarks[ground] = true
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if zoneLevel > 3 then return end

    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= GridType.land and gridType ~= GridType.campfireLand then return end
    local isSpawn = math.random(1,2) == 1
    if not isSpawn then
        task.delay(_animalLifeTime,function()
            _carrotSpawnMarks[ground] = nil
        end)
        return
    end

    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local posX = ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX)
    local posZ = ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ResourcesItemHelper:CreateCarrot(Vector3.new(posX,posY,posZ))

end

function trySpawnHorse(ground:Part)
    if not ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.HorseGround) then return end
    local horseNum = math.random(3,6)
    for i=1,horseNum do
        local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
        local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
        local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
        local pos = Vector3.new(
            ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
            posY,
            ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
        )
        pos = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(pos)
        local horse = GameHelper:CreateHorse("普通马")
        horse:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(math.random(0,359)),0) + pos)
    end
end

-- 生成矿脉
function trySpawnLode(ground:Part)
    -- if not RunService:IsStudio() then return end
    if not ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.LodeGround) then return end
    if ground:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Prefabs) then return end

    if math.random(1,100) > 50 then return end

    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local posX = ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX)
    local posZ = ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)

    local prefabs:{Model} = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("Map"):FindFirstChild("矿脉"):GetChildren()

    local lode:Model = prefabs[math.random(1,#prefabs)]:Clone()
    local pos = Vector3.new(posX,posY,posZ)
    lode:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.PickaxeTarget)
    lode:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Lode)
    lode:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(math.random(0,359)),0) + pos)
    lode.Parent = workspace
end

function trySpawnAnimal(ground:Part)
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 此地块是否会生成
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.land then
        -- 如果非普通地块则不生成
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end

    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == nil then
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
        local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:Get(EnemySetting,EnemySetting.k.refreshZone,zoneLevel)
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = math.random(1,100) <= enemyLo.spawnPercent
    end

    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 是否已经执行过生成，生成过不会再生成
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:Get(EnemySetting,EnemySetting.k.refreshZone,zoneLevel)
    local parent = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(enemyLo.id)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local animal = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(enemyLo.id,parent)
    animal:PivotTo(CFrame.new(
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ))
    animal.Destroying:Connect(function()
        _groundAnimals[ground] = nil
    end)
    _groundAnimals[ground] = animal
    
    -- 如果死掉就不再刷了
    local humanoid:Humanoid = animal:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        animal:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end)
    animal:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
    -- animal:SetAttribute("Grid",string.format("%d,%d",gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z))

    -- Debris:AddItem(enemy,_animalLifeTime)
end

function trySpawnBunny(ground:Part)
    local canSpawn = _groundIsCanSpawnBunny[ground]
    if canSpawn == nil then
        canSpawn = math.random(1,7) == 1
        _groundIsCanSpawnBunny[ground] = canSpawn
    end
    if canSpawn == false then return end
    if _groundBunnys[ground] then return end

    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if zoneLevel > 2 then return end

    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= GridType.land and gridType ~= GridType.campfireLand then return end


    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local bunny:Model = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("动物"):WaitForChild("BunnyModel"):Clone()
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(bunny,NpcAttributeValue)
    bunny:PivotTo(CFrame.new(
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-ground.Size.X,ground.Size.X)/2,
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-ground.Size.Z,ground.Size.Z)/2
    ))
    bunny.Parent = workspace
    -- bunny:SetAttribute("Grid",string.format("%d,%d",gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z))
    bunny.Destroying:Connect(function()
        _groundBunnys[ground] = nil
    end)
    _groundBunnys[ground] = bunny

    -- 如果死掉就不再刷了
    local humanoid:Humanoid = bunny:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        bunny:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
        _groundIsCanSpawnBunny[ground] = false
        task.wait(120)
        _groundIsCanSpawnBunny[ground] = true
    end)
    bunny:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bunny)
    bunny:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)

    -- Debris:AddItem(bunny,_animalLifeTime)
end

function trySpawnStoreAndTree(ground:Part)
    -- 随机树木，石头
    local parent = MapHelper:GetMapParent()

    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    local grid1X = gridPoint.X
    local grid1Z = gridPoint.Z
    if gridType == MapHelper.GridType.campfireLand or gridType == MapHelper.GridType.land then
        if math.abs(grid1X - MapHelper.centerGrid1) < 1 and  math.abs(grid1Z - MapHelper.centerGrid1) < 1 then return end

        local posX = ground.Position.X
        local posZ = ground.Position.Z
        local groundY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2

        -- 随机一些树
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        local treeCount = 0
        if zoneLevel <= 2 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,3)
        elseif zoneLevel <= 4 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,2)
        else
            treeCount = math.random(0,1)
        end
        for i=1,treeCount do
            local prefabName = "TreeL"
            local tag = GameEnum.Tag.Tree
            if math.random(1,5) <= 1 then
                tag = GameEnum.Tag.BigTree
                prefabName = "TreeXL"
            end
            local tree:Model = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("树"):WaitForChild(prefabName):Clone()
            local treeX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
            local treeZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)

            -- local rotationY:number = math.random() * 360
            local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
            tree:PivotTo(CFrame.new(treeX,groundY,treeZ) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0))
            tree.Parent = parent
            tree:AddTag(tag)
        end

        -- 随机石块
        if math.random(1,3) <= 1 then
            local prefab:Model
            local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("Map"):FindFirstChild("石头")
            if folder then
                local childs = folder:GetChildren()
                if #childs > 0 then
                    local stoneX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
                    local stoneZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
                    -- local rotationY = math.random() * 360
                    local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
                    prefab = childs[math.random(1,#childs)]
                    local stone = prefab:Clone()
                    stone:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0)+Vector3.new(stoneX,groundY,stoneZ))
                    -- stone:PivotTo(prefab:GetPivot().Rotation + Vector3.new(stoneX,groundY,stoneZ))
                    stone.Parent = workspace
                    stone:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.DecorativeStones)
                end
            end
        end

        -- 生成雪块
        GameHelper:SpawnSnow(ground)
    end
end

function isAllStreamingOut(npc:Model)
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local ret = true
    for _,player:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local charater = player.Character
        if not charater then continue end

        local distance = (humanoidRootPart.Position - charater:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
        if distance < 160 then
            ret = false
            break
        end
    end

    return ret
end

function getEnterUserTag(player:Player)
    return string.format("EnterUser_%d",player.UserId)
end

function onGroundSpawnExit(player:Player,ground:Part)
    ground:RemoveTag(getEnterUserTag(player))
    for _,otherPlayer:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if ground:HasTag(getEnterUserTag(otherPlayer)) then return end
    end

    if _groundAnimals[ground] then
        local npc = _groundAnimals[ground]
        if npc then
            npc:Destroy()
        end
    end
    if _groundBunnys[ground] then
        local npc = _groundBunnys[ground]
        if npc then
            npc:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

GameHelper.GroundEnterC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,ground:Part)
    -- print("串流进入"..ground.Name)
    -- local nextTime = _nextCheckEnterTime[ground] or 0
    -- local timeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
    -- if timeNow < nextTime then return end

        if not character then continue end

        folderName = "暮年牛仔",
        prefabName = "1x1,暮年牛仔阶段1据点",
        levels = {3},

        prefabName = "1x1,铁商人据点",

    },

        folderName = "牛仔呼救",
        prefabName = "1x1,牛仔呼救阶段1据点",

    },

local NPC_EVENT_POOLS = {
    {
        id = "区域3",
        entries = {
            {eventId = "暮年牛仔", weight = 70},
            {eventId = "拯救小伙3", weight = 30},
        },
    },
    {
        id = "区域4",
        entries = {
            {eventId = "铁商人", weight = 50},
            {eventId = "牛仔呼救", weight = 50},
        },
    },
}

local v_gameMode = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("游戏模式")
local _init = false

local function normalizeWeight(poolId, entry)
    local weight = entry.weight
    if typeof(weight) ~= "number" or weight < 0 or weight ~= weight or weight == math.huge then
        warn(string.format("NPCEvent: invalid weight in %s for %s", poolId, tostring(entry.eventId)))
        return 0
    end
    return weight
end

local function buildWeightedOrder(pool, forcedEventId)
    local remaining = {}
    local totalWeight = 0
    for _, entry in ipairs(pool.entries) do
        local weight = normalizeWeight(pool.id, entry)
        table.insert(remaining, {
            entry = entry,
            weight = weight,
        })
        totalWeight += weight
    end

    if totalWeight <= 0 then
        warn(string.format("NPCEvent: %s has no positive weights; falling back to equal weights", pool.id))
        for _, candidate in ipairs(remaining) do
            candidate.weight = 1
        end
    else
        for index = #remaining, 1, -1 do
            if remaining[index].weight <= 0 and remaining[index].entry.eventId ~= forcedEventId then
                table.remove(remaining, index)
            end
        end
    end

    local order = {}
    local forcedMatched = false
    if forcedEventId ~= "" then
        for index, candidate in ipairs(remaining) do
            if candidate.entry.eventId == forcedEventId then
                table.insert(order, candidate.entry)
                table.remove(remaining, index)
                forcedMatched = true
                break
            end
        end
    end

    while #remaining > 0 do
        local currentTotal = 0
        for _, candidate in ipairs(remaining) do
            currentTotal += candidate.weight
        end

        local selectedIndex = 1
        if currentTotal > 0 then
            local roll = eventRandom:NextNumber(0, currentTotal)
            local cumulative = 0
            for index, candidate in ipairs(remaining) do
                cumulative += candidate.weight
                if roll <= cumulative then
                    selectedIndex = index
                    break
                end
            end
        else
            selectedIndex = eventRandom:NextInteger(1, #remaining)
        end

        table.insert(order, remaining[selectedIndex].entry)
        table.remove(remaining, selectedIndex)
    end

    return order, forcedMatched
end

local function spawnConfiguredEvent(eventId)
    local definition = EVENT_DEFINITIONS[eventId]
    if not definition then
        warn("NPCEvent: missing definition for", eventId)
        return nil
    end

    local eventFolder = npcEventsFolder:FindFirstChild(definition.folderName)
    local prefab = eventFolder and eventFolder:FindFirstChild(definition.prefabName)
    if not prefab then
        warn("NPCEvent: missing prefab for", eventId)
        return nil
    end

    local spawnOk, buildingOrError = pcall(spawnBuilding, prefab, definition.levels, true)
    if not spawnOk then
        warn(string.format("NPCEvent: failed to spawn %s: %s", eventId, tostring(buildingOrError)))
        return nil
    end

    local building = buildingOrError
    if not building then
        warn("NPCEvent: no safe spawn point for", eventId)
        return nil
    end

    if definition.startsOldCowboyQuest then
        local questOk, questOrError = pcall(function()
            local OldCowboyQuestService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("OldCowboyQuestService"))
            return OldCowboyQuestService.Start(building, spawnBuilding)
        end)
        if not questOk or not questOrError then
            warn(string.format("NPCEvent: failed to start %s: %s", eventId, tostring(questOrError)))
            building:Destroy()
            return nil
        end
    end

    return building
end

local function cleanupUnselectedEvents(selectedEvents)
    for eventId, definition in pairs(EVENT_DEFINITIONS) do
        if not selectedEvents[eventId] then
            local eventFolder = npcEventsFolder:FindFirstChild(definition.folderName)
            if eventFolder then
                eventFolder:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
end

local function init()
    if not MapHelper.isInit then return end
    if _init then return end

    _init = true

    local forcedEventId = ""
    if RunService:IsStudio() then
        forcedEventId = forcedEventValue.Value
    end

    local selectedEvents = {}
    local forcedMatched = false
    for _, pool in ipairs(NPC_EVENT_POOLS) do
        local order, matched = buildWeightedOrder(pool, forcedEventId)
        forcedMatched = forcedMatched or matched

        local selectedEventId
        for _, entry in ipairs(order) do
            if spawnConfiguredEvent(entry.eventId) then
                selectedEventId = entry.eventId
                selectedEvents[selectedEventId] = true
                break
            end
        end

        if selectedEventId then
            print(string.format("NPCEvent: %s selected %s", pool.id, selectedEventId))
        else
            warn(string.format("NPCEvent: all candidates failed in %s", pool.id))
        end
    end

    if forcedEventId ~= "" and not forcedMatched then
        warn("NPCEvent: invalid Studio override", forcedEventId)
    end

    cleanupUnselectedEvents(selectedEvents)
end

function spawnBuilding(prefab:Model,levels:{number},destroyPrefab:boolean?)
    local size = MapHelper:GetResPointSize(prefab)
    local sizeX,sizeZ = MapHelper:RandomBuildingSize(size.X,size.Y)
    local grounds:{Part} = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Ground)
    for i=1,#grounds do
        local ground = table.remove(grounds,math.random(1,#grounds))
        local grid1Vo = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
        local grid1X = grid1Vo.X
        local grid1Z = grid1Vo.Z
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        if table.find(levels,zoneLevel) == nil then
            continue
        end
        if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.land) then continue end
        local building = MapHelper:CreateBuilding(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.building,prefab)
        MapHelper:initBuilding(building,MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z))
        print("生成",prefab.Name,grid1X,grid1Z)
        if destroyPrefab then
            prefab:Destroy()
        end
        return building
    end
end

function onTagAdded(tool:Tool, connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local light = tool.LightPart
    local sound = tool.Blade.Draw
    local v_Energy = tool.Values.Energy
    local energyMax = tool.Values.EnergyMax.Value
    local v_IsBlock = tool.Values.IsBlock
    local Trail = tool.Trail
    local SetBlockC2S = tool.Events.SetBlockC2S
    local character:Model = nil
    local trailCD = 0
    Trail.Enabled = false

    local enableTrail = function(t:number)
        Trail.Enabled = true
        trailCD = math.max(t,trailCD)
    end

    local setBlock = function(isBlock:boolean)
        if v_IsBlock.Value == isBlock then return end
        
        v_IsBlock.Value = isBlock
        
        if character then
            local v_damageReduction:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,CharacterValue.damageReduction)
            if isBlock then
                v_damageReduction.Value += 0.2
                character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.BlockAttack)
            else
                v_damageReduction.Value -= 0.2
                character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.BlockAttack)
            end
        end
    end

    local onCheckSkillBuff = function(isEquipped:boolean)
        if not character then return end
        
        local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
        if not player then return end
        
        if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.JediV1) then
            --local v_walkSpeed:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus)
            local bouns = 3
            if isEquipped then
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,"LightSaber",3)
                --v_walkSpeed.Value += bouns
            else
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,"LightSaber",0)
                --v_walkSpeed.Value -= bouns
            end
        end
        
        if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.JediV2) then
            local humanoid:Humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
            local bouns = 15
            if isEquipped then
                humanoid.MaxHealth += bouns
            else
                humanoid.MaxHealth -= bouns
            end	
            humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.Health,humanoid.MaxHealth)
        end
    end

    GameHelper.CharacterHitTargetC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,target:Model)
        if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        local handTool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
        if handTool ~= tool then return end

        local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
        local damage = tonumber(resLo.param)
        if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.JediV3) then
            damage *= 1.5
        end
        GameHelper:PlayerMeleeWeaponHitTarget(player,target,damage)
    end)

    tool.Activated:Connect(function() 
        enableTrail(0.5)
    end)

    tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
        character = tool.Parent
        onCheckSkillBuff(true)

        tool.Blade.PointLight.Enabled = true
        sound:Play()
        light.Part1.Transparency = 0
        task.wait(.07)
        light.Part2.Transparency = 0
        task.wait(.07)
        light.Part3.Transparency = 0
        task.wait(.07)
        light.Part4.Transparency = 0
    end)

    tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
        onCheckSkillBuff(false)

        tool.Blade.PointLight.Enabled = false
        light.Part1.Transparency = 1
        light.Part2.Transparency = 1
        light.Part3.Transparency = 1
        light.Part4.Transparency = 1

        -- 这里优先级一定要比 character = nil 高，因为要清空格挡状态相关加成
        setBlock(false)

        if character then
            character = nil
        end
    end)

    v_Energy.Changed:Connect(function(value: number)
        if value <= 0 then
            setBlock(false)
        end
    end)

    SetBlockC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, isBlock:boolean)
        setBlock(isBlock)
    end)

    GameHelper.BlockBulletC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,enemy:Model,damage:number,bulletPrefab:BasePart?)
        if player.Character ~= character then return end

        enableTrail(0.2)
    end)

    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
        if trailCD > 0 then
            trailCD -= dt
            if trailCD <= 0 then
                Trail.Enabled = false
            end
        end

        if v_IsBlock.Value then
            if v_Energy.Value > 0 then
                v_Energy.Value = math.clamp(v_Energy.Value - dt,0,energyMax)
            end
        else
            if v_Energy.Value < energyMax then
                v_Energy.Value = math.clamp(v_Energy.Value + dt,0,energyMax)
            end
        end
    end))
end

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))

local MapHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("MapHelper"))

local DragItemValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.DragItemValue

local emptyStorePrefab:Tool = workspace.Prefabs.Map:FindFirstChild("铃铛洞穴"):FindFirstChild("空宝石")
local CD = 30 * 60 -- 30 分钟刷一次

function createStoreDisplay(prefab:Tool,cframe:CFrame,parent:Instance)
    local store = prefab:Clone()
    CommonFunc:SetCanCollision(store,false)
    local Handle:Part = store:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    Handle.Anchored = true
    if not prefab.PrimaryPart then
        prefab.PrimaryPart = Handle
    end
    store:PivotTo(cframe)
    if parent then
        store.Parent = parent
    end
    return store
end

function createEmptyStoreDisplay(cframe:CFrame,parent:Instance)
    local store = emptyStorePrefab:Clone()
    store:PivotTo(cframe)
    if parent then
        store.Parent = parent
    end
    return store
end

function onTagCaveAdded(bellCave:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local rootFolder:Folder = bellCave:FindFirstChild("铃铛洞穴")
    local soltFolder:Folder = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("宝石槽位")
    local tempClue:Tool = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("线索")
    local DoorPart:Part = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("DoorPart")
    local ProximityPrompt:ProximityPrompt = DoorPart:FindFirstChild("ProximityPrompt")
    local v_storeId:IntValue = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("宝石id")
    local v_battleGround:ObjectValue = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("战场")
    local storePrefab:Tool = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("Resources"):FindFirstChild(tostring(v_storeId.Value))

    local clueCFrame:Frame = tempClue:GetPivot()
    tempClue:Destroy()
    ProximityPrompt.Enabled = false

    CommonFunc:SetParticleEmittersEnabled(DoorPart,false)

    local emptySolts:{Tool} = {}
    -- 创建线索
    createStoreDisplay(storePrefab,clueCFrame,rootFolder)
    -- 创建槽位
    for _,solt:Tool in ipairs(soltFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if not solt:IsA("Tool") or solt.Name ~= "point" then continue end
        local cframe:CFrame = solt:GetPivot()
        solt:Destroy()
        local emptyStore = createEmptyStoreDisplay(cframe,soltFolder)
        local TouchPart:Part = emptyStore:FindFirstChild("TouchPart")
        TouchPart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
            if not TouchPart.CanTouch then return end
            local isResItem,resItem = ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(otherPart)
            if not isResItem then return end

            -- 不能在玩家手中
            if resItem.Parent:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) then return end

            local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(resItem)
            if not resItemLo or resItemLo.id ~= v_storeId.Value then return end

            -- 消耗掉这个道具
            local startCFrame = resItem:GetPivot()
            ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(resItem)

            -- 关闭Touch
            TouchPart.CanTouch = false

            -- 从列表里移除
            local index = table.find(emptySolts,emptyStore)
            if index then
                table.remove(emptySolts,index)
            end
            -- 移除空石头
            emptyStore:Destroy()

            -- 是否最后一个石头
            local isLast = #emptySolts <= 0

            -- 创建石头镶嵌
            local store = createStoreDisplay(storePrefab,startCFrame,soltFolder)
            local Handle:Part = store:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("镶嵌",Handle)
            local tween = TweenService:Create(Handle,TweenInfo.new(1),{
                CFrame = cframe
            })

            tween.Completed:Connect(function()
                -- 播放个特效
                EffectHelper:PlayEffect("火花",cframe.Position,nil,0.5)
                AudioHelper:PlayEffect("镶嵌2",Handle)
                -- 检测开关
                if isLast then
                    -- 打开传送门特效
                    CommonFunc:SetParticleEmittersEnabled(DoorPart,true)

                    -- 打开交互按钮
                    ProximityPrompt.Enabled = true

                    task.wait(1)
                    -- 播放传送门音效
                    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("传送门开启",DoorPart)
                end
            end)
            tween:Play()
        end)
        table.insert(emptySolts,emptyStore)
    end

    ProximityPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(playerWhoTriggered)
        local att:Attachment = v_battleGround.Value:FindFirstChild("传送点")
        GameHelper:FastTravel(playerWhoTriggered,att.WorldCFrame.Position,true)
    end)
end

function onBattleGroundTagAdded(battleGround:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local v_enter:ObjectValue = battleGround:FindFirstChild("Values"):FindFirstChild("入口")
    local v_dropBellId:IntValue = battleGround:FindFirstChild("Values"):FindFirstChild("掉落铃铛id")
    local v_BossSpawn_CD:IntValue = battleGround:FindFirstChild("Values"):FindFirstChild("BossSpawn_CD")

    local rootFolder:Folder = battleGround:FindFirstChild("战场")
    local ZonePart = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("ZonePart")
    local DoorPart:Part = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("DoorPart")
    local TreasurePoints:Folder = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("TreasurePoints")
    local BellPoint:Tool = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("BellPoint")
    local ProximityPrompt:ProximityPrompt = DoorPart:FindFirstChild("ProximityPrompt")
    local BillboardGui:BillboardGui = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("UIAtt"):FindFirstChild("BillboardGui")

    BillboardGui.Enabled = false

    local bellCFrame = BellPoint:GetPivot()
    BellPoint:Destroy()

    local killTimes = 0
    local _treasures:{Model} = {}

    local clearTreasures = function()
        for _,oldTreasure in ipairs(_treasures) do
            oldTreasure:Destroy()
        end
        table.clear(_treasures)
    end

    local createTreasures = function()
        clearTreasures()
        for _,att:Attachment in ipairs(TreasurePoints:GetChildren()) do
            table.insert(_treasures,GameHelper:CreateTreasureByName(att.Name,att.WorldCFrame))
        end
    end

    local spawnSomething = function()
        local bossAtt:Attachment = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("Boss出生点")
        local bossId:number = bossAtt:GetAttribute("EnemyId")

        local boss = EnemyHelper:Create(bossId,EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(bossId))
        local humanoid:Humanoid = boss:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        boss:PivotTo(bossAtt.WorldCFrame)
        boss:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyBoss)
        -- boss:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject)

        -- 递增最大血量
        humanoid.MaxHealth += killTimes * 1000
        humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth

        -- 创建铃铛
        local bell = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(v_dropBellId.Value,bellCFrame)
        bell.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
        ValueHelper:SetValue(bell,DragItemValue.enable,false)

        -- 生成小怪
        local minionFolder = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParentFromName(battleGround.Name.."小怪")
        local xiaoguaiFolder:Folder = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("小怪出生点")
        if xiaoguaiFolder then
            for _,att:Attachment in ipairs(xiaoguaiFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if att:IsA("Attachment") then
                    local enemyId = tonumber(att.Name)
                    local enemy = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,minionFolder)
                    enemy:PivotTo(att.WorldCFrame)
                end
            end
        end

        humanoid.Died:Once(function()
            killTimes += 1
            -- 创建宝箱
            createTreasures()
            -- 解锁铃铛
            ValueHelper:SetValue(bell,DragItemValue.enable,true)

            -- 击杀所有小怪
            for _,enemy in ipairs(minionFolder:GetChildren()) do
                GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(nil,enemy,999999)
            end

            -- 创建铃铛特效
            local effect = EffectHelper:PlayEffect("摇铃",bellCFrame.Position,nil)
            local clearEff = function()
                if effect then
                    EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,0)
                    effect = nil
                end
            end
            bell.PrimaryPart:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Once(clearEff)
            bell.AncestryChanged:Once(clearEff)
            -- 赋值刷新时间
            v_BossSpawn_CD.Value = workspace.DistributedGameTime + CD -- 30 分钟刷一次
        end)
    end

    spawnSomething()
    table.insert(connections,v_BossSpawn_CD.Changed:Connect(function()
        local targetTime = v_BossSpawn_CD.Value
        while true do
            task.wait(1)
            if targetTime ~= v_BossSpawn_CD.Value then return end -- 被修改过，废弃这次流程

            local timeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime

            local cd = math.clamp(targetTime - timeNow,0,CD)
	        BillboardGui.Enabled = cd > 0
	        BillboardGui.t_time.Text = string.format("👑%s",CommonFunc:TimeToStrAuto(cd))
            if cd <= 0 then
                break
            end
        end
        clearTreasures()
        spawnSomething()
    end))

    table.insert(connections,ZonePart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart: BasePart)
        local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
        if not character then return end
        local Torso:Part = character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        if otherPart ~= Torso then return end
        GameHelper:UpdateCharacterInArea(ZonePart,GameEnum.Tag.OnBellCaveBattleGround)
    end))

    table.insert(connections,ZonePart.TouchEnded:Connect(function(otherPart: BasePart)
        local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
        if not character then return end
        local Torso:Part = character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        if otherPart ~= Torso then return end
        GameHelper:UpdateCharacterInArea(ZonePart,GameEnum.Tag.OnBellCaveBattleGround)
    end))

    table.insert(connections,ProximityPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(playerWhoTriggered: Player)
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(playerWhoTriggered) then return end

        local part:Part = v_enter.Value:FindFirstChild("铃铛洞穴"):FindFirstChild("DoorPart")
        GameHelper:FastTravel(playerWhoTriggered,part.Position)
    end))

function trySpawnStoreAndTree(ground:Part)
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType == MapHelper.GridType.Snowfield then
        local grid1X = gridPoint.X
        local grid1Z = gridPoint.Z
        local posX = ground.Position.X
        local posZ = ground.Position.Z
        local groundY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2

        -- 随机一些树
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        local treeCount = 0
        if zoneLevel <= 2 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,3)
        elseif zoneLevel <= 4 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,2)
        else
            treeCount = math.random(0,1)
        end
        for i=1,treeCount do
            local prefabName = "TreeL"
            local tag = GameEnum.Tag.Tree
            if math.random(1,5) <= 1 then
                tag = GameEnum.Tag.BigTree
                prefabName = "TreeXL"
            end
            local tree:Model = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("雪原Map"):WaitForChild("树"):WaitForChild(prefabName):Clone()
            local treeX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
            local treeZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)

            -- local rotationY:number = math.random() * 360
            local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
            tree:PivotTo(CFrame.new(treeX,groundY,treeZ) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0))
            tree.Parent = workspace
            tree:AddTag(tag)
        end

        -- 随机石块
        if math.random(1,3) <= 1 then
            spawnStore(ground)
        end
    end

    -- 在边缘的地块上生成一些装饰
    if ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.SnowfieldEdgeGround) then
        local r = 1
        for offsetX =-r,r do
            for offsetZ=-r, r do
                local grid1X = gridPoint.X + offsetX
                local grid1Z = gridPoint.Z + offsetZ
                if MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z) == MapHelper.GridType.land then
                    local g = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
                    if g:HasTag("SpawnedEdgeStore") then continue end
                    g:AddTag("SpawnedEdgeStore")
                    MapHelper:SpawnSnow(g)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
